component.name: Pokémon TCG Live
component.summary: Play Pokémon TCG Live on Linux

description.p: PTCGL-Linux is an unofficial Linux compatibility package for Pokémon TCG Live.

On first launch, the application prepares a managed Proton compatibility environment and downloads and verifies the official Pokémon TCG Live installer. The game itself is not distributed inside this Flatpak.

Subsequent launches start Pokémon TCG Live directly. Browser-based account authentication is integrated with the Linux desktop and delivered to the running game through the managed compatibility environment.
This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by The Pokémon Company International.

ul.li: Report the installed release version correctly from the command line.
Launching the Flatpak directly now starts Pokémon TCG Live instead of displaying CLI help.

description.p: Initial development release of the Flatpak application.

ul.li: Automatic first-launch setup of the compatibility environment.
Verified installation of Pokémon TCG Live.
Direct game launch after initial setup.
